comment: Dr. Fillerup is genuinely very kind though she can be a bit scattered in terms of remembering to explain assignments. Some of her projects are unrelated to class and definitely very time consuming, but if you put in some effort she will def notice. You absolutely need to participate every class, and show that you are trying.

The class I had was easy because it was an art/embodied communication class, but she may be harder for other classes. She cares a lot about participation and group work. Also, journals every week, but they're not graded harshly. She likes it when you care about the topic or show that you did the readings.
Dr. Fillerup is the nicest, more caring teacher I have ever had. I had her for MUS 209, which was a boring topic, but she did her best to make it interesting. Every class is discussion based.

Dr Fillerup is a wonderful professor, though her class was harder than I expected. There are readings every class and you're expected to participate. The class has 3 big assignments which means your grade is very dependent on them. Make sure you set aside enough time for these because they take longer than you think. Very interesting course though!

Dr. F is amazing. I have had her for two classes now, and I would recommend her to anyone who loves music/opera history. She truly cares about her students and is always willing to help with assignments outside of class! Take Dr.F's class!

Dr. Fillerup is a good facilitator of discussions that take place in most classes. Most of the discussions, however, are not relevant to the 3 semester projects, 2 of which have significant group components. She is fairly clear with her expectations and provides rubrics for each assignment. She provides written and concise feedback on written work.

Professor Fillerup's Music and Meaning class was super interesting and the materials touched upon race, gender, and disability in music. The workload is super manageable and you get to grade yourself. However, she doesn't offer much guidance on talks or essays so expect to complete the work by yourself without much guidance or feedback.

Professor Fillerup is not really accessible outside the classroom if you need her to provide extra feedback in projects but you can pretty much do everything on your own. There's a lot of flexibility in her class , and I found the readings to be very interesting as they talk about sexuality, race and how that impacts the process of music making.
She will help you out if you ask. Requires participation but that helps you learn about stuff.
Should not be allowed to teach. She grades extremely unfairly and she is not helpful avoid her classes at all costs.
She's super engaging. If your even mildly interested in the topic, she'll make it more interesting.
very hard class!!!! she also grade harshly!!!!! take seriously consider before you register
She is very understanding and a nice person who loves for you to participate. Coming to class is necessary or you can not participate.
